nonblocking_clarifications.suggested_text: If C(N) is empty, set r_C(N)=0 and interpret the supremum in (1) as zero in the nonnegative extended half-line.
nonblocking_clarifications.effect: No change to positive-radius, non-elementary, or Schottky claims.
